description: Was there a big solar flare today? Lists X-ray flares detected by the GOES satellites in the last 1-7 days, newest first, with class (A, B, C, M, X), begin, peak and end times, peak flux and the NOAA radio blackout level implied, plus the largest flare in the period. From NOAA SWPC. It covers flares only, not CMEs or whether a flare will affect Earth. (cost: 1 credit)

days.description: integer, optional, look-back in days (1-7), default 7

limit.description: integer, optional, max flares to list (1-100), default 25

min_class.description: string, optional, only flares of this class or stronger: C, M or X

name: solar_flares_recent
